site.name: notion
site.summary: notion-clone Clone of the Notion marketing funnel: home + product sub-pages + templates + pricing. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: top nav (Product / Download / Solutions / Resources / Pricing / Request demo / Log in / Get Notion free), hero section (product positioning + CTA + main screenshot), modular product intros (Docs / Wikis / Projects / AI), customer logo wall, customer stories, multi-column footer | | `projects.html` | Project management sub-page: feature highlights, view-switching screenshots (Board / Timeline / Calendar), case studies, CTA | | `wikis.html` | Wiki sub-page: knowledge-base examples, permissions / search / template features, CTA |

run_plan.goal: Validate the UX consistency, navigation flow, and mobile responsiveness of the Notion marketing clone, specifically focusing on the transition between product pillars (Projects, Wikis) and the pricing structure.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will begin by validating the global navigation and primary CTAs on the landing page. It will then traverse the specific product sub-pages (Projects, Wikis, Templates) to ensure content relevance and consistent header/footer behavior. Finally, it will audit the Pricing page for toggle interactions and FAQ accordions, while simultaneously checking for mobile layout regressions given the prescan warnings about small tap targets.
assumptions: The 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' buttons in the nav trigger modals or external redirects rather than navigating to new HTML files within this static set.
The 'Templates' link maps directly to 'templates-projects.html' as indicated by the href.
The site relies heavily on CSS flex/grid which may break on narrow viewports given the 'small_tap_target' warnings.
risk_hotspots: Global Navigation Bar: High density of links with reported small tap targets (<44px height) on mobile.
Pricing Toggle: Interaction state change between Monthly/Yearly billing.
FAQ Accordions: Expansion/collapse behavior on pricing and template pages.
Mobile Viewport: Layout overflow or unreadable text due to fixed-width elements.

phases.title: Landing Page & Global Nav Validation
phases.objective: Verify the integrity of the home page hero section and the persistence of the global navigation bar.
key_checks: Click 'Projects', 'Wikis', 'Templates', and 'Pricing' links to verify correct routing.
Inspect the 'Get Notion free' and 'Request a demo' buttons for interaction feedback (hover/active states).
Scroll to the bottom to verify footer links match top-level navigation options.
exit_criteria: All top-level nav links successfully route to their respective HTML files.
Hero section CTA is visible and clickable.

phases.title: Product Pillar Deep Dive
phases.objective: Explore the specific feature pages to validate content hierarchy and internal linking strategies.
key_checks: On Projects/Wikis pages, verify that the 'Get Notion free' CTA persists in the hero area.
Check for cross-linking: Does the Projects page link to Wikis and vice versa?
On Templates page, identify if category filters (e.g., 'Roadmaps', 'Issue Tracking') are interactive or static text.
Verify that the 'Back to Home' or Logo click returns to index.html.
exit_criteria: Confirmed presence of primary CTAs on each sub-page.
Validated that internal links do not lead to 404s.

phases.title: Pricing Logic & Interactive Elements
phases.objective: Test dynamic UI components on the Pricing page, specifically toggles and accordions.
key_checks: Interact with the 'Monthly / Yearly' toggle to observe price updates in the plan cards.
Expand at least two FAQ accordion items (e.g., 'How does Notion AI use my data?') to check for layout shifts.
Verify visual distinction between the 'Free', 'Plus', and 'Business' tiers.
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle successfully updates displayed values.
FAQ accordions expand and collapse without breaking layout.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility Audit
phases.objective: Re-visit critical pages on a mobile viewport to address prescan warnings regarding tap targets.
key_checks: Attempt to tap nav links; verify if they overlap or are too small (<44px).
Check for horizontal scrolling issues on the Pricing table/cards.
Verify readability of hero text on smaller screens.
exit_criteria: No critical layout breakage (overlapping text, unscrollable areas) on mobile.
Documented severity of tap-target issues observed in prescan.

coverage_targets.pages: 100% of known HTML files (index, pricing, projects, wikis, templates-projects)
coverage_targets.features: Nav links, Pricing Toggle, FAQ Accordions, Primary CTAs
coverage_targets.mobile: Critical path (Home -> Pricing) tested on mobile viewport

notes: Prescan indicates 'small_tap_target' warnings on almost all nav items; prioritize checking these in Phase 4.
The 'Request a demo' button uses 'javascript:void(0)', suggesting it may open a modal or do nothing in this static clone; observe console for errors if clicked.
Ensure the browser back-button works correctly when navigating from sub-pages back to Home.

observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. Yes. Teams use Notion to manage plans, tasks, timelines, docs, and status updates in one place. Because templates are composable, you can tailor workflows without duct-taping multiple tools together. What project management templates should I start with? Start with a project plan, timeline (Gantt), WBS, RACI, and a weekly status report. These cover the four fundamentals: scope, schedule, ownership, and communication. Can I manage Agile projects in Notion? Yes. Use a backlog and sprint board (Kanban), plus a timeline for capacity planning. Add retrospectives and a change log to complete the loop. What does "composable project management" mean? It's the idea of building your system from modular parts that can be reconfigured as needs change. Your project management tool, built by you, for you. Engineering Lead Marcus Johnson Product Designer Aisha Patel Frontend Engineer James Kim Backend Engineer Team Directory by danyanovich FAQs Is Notion good for project management? Yes. Teams use Notion to manage plans, tasks, timelines, docs, and status updates in one place. Because templates are composable, you can tailor workflows without duct-taping multiple tools together. What project management templates should I start with? Start with a project plan, timeline (Gantt), WBS, RACI, and a weekly status report. These cover the four fundamentals: scope, schedule, ownership, and communication. Can I manage Agile projects in Notion? Yes. Use a backlog and sprint board (Kanban), plus a timeline for capacity planning. Add retrospectives and a change log to complete the loop. What does "composable project management" mean? It's the idea of building your system from modular parts that can be reconfigured as needs change. Your project management tool, built by you, for you. Does Notion support templates for different industries? Yes, Notion offers project templates for various industries, from software and marketing to construction and educ

Yes. Teams use Notion to manage plans, tasks, timelines, docs, and status updates in one place. Because templates are composable, you can tailor workflows without duct-taping multiple tools together. What project management templates should I start with? Start with a project plan, timeline (Gantt), WBS, RACI, and a weekly status report. These cover the four fundamentals: scope, schedule, ownership, and communication. Can I manage Agile projects in Notion? Yes. Use a backlog and sprint board (Kanban), plus a timeline for capacity planning. Add retrospectives and a change log to complete the loop. What does "composable project management" mean? It's the idea of building your system from modular parts that can be reconfigured as needs change. Your project management tool, built by you, for you. observation.title: Notion Wikis – The wiki that redefines 'wiki'
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free WIKIS The wiki that redefines 'wiki'. It's hard to move fast if you've got a clunky and disorganized workspace. Centralize all your knowledge in Notion instead. Get Notion free Company home Brand guidelines IT Hub Employee onboarding The new default for knowledge and documentation OpenAI Figma Volvo Nvidia Find, edit, browse. We craft an experience you'll love. Every team's files, at a glance Notion's sidebar keeps your workspace organized no matter how fast you grow. Search that actually works Powerful filters let anyone find data and decisions across teams in seconds. Beautiful out of the box Pick the perfect emoji and cover image for every page to reflect your company's brand. Drag and drop organization Everyone can contribute to your knowledge base. No need to be tech-savvy just to update a page. Link to other pages easily Everything is connected in your workspace — just type @ to link your notes or roadmap in a doc. Waste less time answering questions & updating docs. Synced Blocks — Keep content updated, automatically. Have the same content in multiple places? Edit it once, and Synced Blocks will apply the changes everywhere else. Verification Never wonder "is this the latest version?" Trust that the info you find is accurate and up-to-date.
